hook.text: Restaurants miss up to forty-three percent of their calls — right in the dinner rush. Six in ten of those callers wanted to order or book a table.

save.text: Order read back, allergy flagged, dessert upsold, ticket on the kitchen printer — while the staff kept serving the room.

res.text: Reservations go straight onto the floor plan — party size, time, occasion, table.

cta.text: Want your phone answered during the rush? Let's build it.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Luca's Trattoria, this is Gia — pickup or a table tonight?

call1.speaker: caller
call1.text: Pickup. Two margherita pizzas, one with no basil, and a Caesar salad. Oh — my son has a nut allergy.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Got it: two margheritas, one no basil, one Caesar, nut allergy flagged for the kitchen. Our tiramisu is nut-free tonight — add one?

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Perfect. That's forty-eight fifty, ready at seven-fifteen. I've texted you the receipt and pickup link.

call2.speaker: caller
call2.text: Hi, table for four tonight around seven-thirty? It's our anniversary.

call2.speaker: alex
call2.text: Happy anniversary! Seven-thirty for four — I've got you at a window table, and I've noted the occasion for the team. You'll get a text confirmation now.
